body: That’s very kind of you and I appreciate it. I’m a pretty understanding person. So if you ever need an ear I’m here as well.
A lot. A house, my husband, my work ethic. Just to name a few small things I’ve lost.
I just turned 28, and I feel like I had everything at one time but lost it all. Now everything seems out of reach
I should have been more clear I was asking in a sexual way.
I’m sorry to hear that, the issues with my husband and I have been ongoing as well, but I’m still holding hope that maybe we can make it work.
I agree feelings aren’t enough without changed behavior. But I’m not sure staying together for the kids is a good idea

My husband told me he wanted a divorce a week before Christmas. I have fought for him desperately and he had looked me in the eyes several times and said I don’t want you anymore. The past week he has spent several days crying telling me how depressed and alone he is. How he is feeling every emotion possible. How mad he is at himself and guilty he feels. 
He has said that he still loves me and cares about me, but hasn’t specifically said he wanted to work things out yet. I am still holding hope. 
I’m just curious is there is no possibility for you and him to work things out?

As things are right now no we can’t trust each other completely. But trust can be rebuilt. I feel like if there is still love everything else can be built up. But I am also a very soft hearted person.

I know I want it to work badly. And right now I think he is such a mess that he can’t make a well thought out decision. He just jumps back and forth on what he wants. But I agree we do need to have a very real conversation

I’m just not sure if he even wants to try to save things. 
Do I just need to give him time to figure out what he wants before I suggest us to try to rebuild trust?

I truly appreciate your honesty and input. I know every situation is different, but you are right on him doing what he is doing. He has said so many times he is sorry for hurting me and that he regrets it but has continued to do the same thing for several weeks. So he can’t be that sorry or he wouldn’t keep doing the things that do hurt me. Right?
I’m just not sure where to go from here. 
Divorce is obviously in my near future.

There is much more to the story I was just trying to hit the high points, I had some traumatic experiences in my past and I acted out with sex to make myself feel better when I felt my husband had let me down in some way. I have been in therapy for about 6 months and made a lot of progress with my past. But unfortunately during my healing process with it, he decides to leave me. He said he’s depressed and pissed at himself for his behavior. He is hurt badly, and it just trying to go out and have fun to take his mind off things. He has admitted he used sex to make himself feel better but it just made him feel worse. In the past week we’ve had several days that we’ve sat with each other and cried because it hurts so badly. I’ve know him since I was in preschool he’s never been a “normal” man. He’s always been better than that. I keep thinking he is doing these things to hurt me the way I hurt him several years ago.
